text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan
Pengangkutan Awam Darat (Penetapan Kategori Perkhidmatan
Bas Ekspres) 2022.

Kategori dan spesifikasi perkhidmatan bas ekspres

2. (1) Hendaklah ada dua kategori  perkhidmatan bas ekspres seperti  yang
berikut:

(a) bas ekspres ekonomi; dan
(b) bas ekspres eksekutif.

(2) Spesifikasi perkhidmatan bas ekspres ekonomi dan eksekutif hendaklah
mengikut spesifikasi sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

Pembatalan

3. Peraturan-Peraturan Pengangkutan Awam Darat (Penetapan Kategori
Perkhidmatan Bas Ekspres) 2021 [P.U. (A) 421/2021] dibatalkan.

LAND PUBLIC TRANSPORT ACT 2010

LAND PUBLIC TRANSPORT
(PRESCRIPTION OF CATEGORY OF EXPRESS BUS SERVICES) REGULATIONS

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraphs 252(1) (tr) and (u) and
subsection 252(2) of the L and Public Transport Act 2010 [ Act 715], the Minister makes
the following regulations:

Citation
1. These regulations may be cited as the Land Public Transport (Prescription of
Category of Express Bus Services) Regulations 2022.

Category and specification of express bus services
2. (1) There shall be two categories of express bus services as follows:

(a) economy express bus; and

(b) executive express bus.

(2) Specifications of economy and executive express bus services shall be in
accordance with the specifications as specified in the Schedule.

Revocation
3. The Land Public Transport (Prescription of Category of Express Bus Services)
Regulations 2021 [P.U. (A) 421/2021] are revoked.
